fields.Name: Skip ICF - YTD Revenue by Month
fields.Description: Monthly confirmed order revenue for the current year (2026) from MJ_BizApps_Orders: Order Headers, with drill-down to the orders. Ported from "YTD Revenue by Month" (invoices become order headers).

InputDefinition.userMessage: Show me our total revenue from confirmed orders for this year, broken down by month in a bar chart. When I click on a month, I want to see the orders for that month. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a bar chart (or similar) of revenue by month for the current year (2026)
Revenue comes from the Orders domain (Order Headers / Order Lines), using confirmed sales orders rather than drafts, quotes or voided orders
Months are in chronological order and values are formatted as currency
Only 2026 data is included; January 2026 is the largest month (renewal season), and there is little or no confirmed revenue after June
Clicking a month drills down to a table of the orders in that month (order number, date, bill-to person, amount)
Order rows can open the underlying order record
